message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, 3 of 3.

The change is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes the title (Unicode NFD) and strips the combining accent marks before passing it to slugify. That's needed because slugify drops any non-ASCII letter outright.

I didn't touch `vendor/slugify`, because its header says not to edit it by hand. `src/shop/product-url.js` also uses it, so shop URLs still drop accented letters (a product called "Café Mug" becomes `caf-mug`). Applying the same normalization there would be a one-line change, if you want it.
